system.description:
“I hurt myself today, to see if I still feel”

There is strength in pain endured and scars embraced. Brokens have extraordinary psionic abilities – but they were not born with these, nor were they gifted to them. All Brokens were shaped by trauma and tragedy: they are the results of gruesome and immoral experiments, lived through unimaginable suffering in a catastrophic event, or they experienced a single, defining moment of loss of a loved one. As a result they are fractured… some physical, some psychological. Their raw and unstable powers are often not only dangerous for their enemies, but for themselves too.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v1.0 Heart

backgroundQuestions: Who turned you into what you are – and why do you believe they broke you on purpose?
What scar or mutation do you hide – and what happens when someone sees it?
What part of your power frightens even you – and why haven’t you learned to control it?
Whose life was destroyed when your instability erupted – and why do you still carry the guilt?
What’s the one boundary you swore you’d never cross – and why do you know deep down you already will?
connections: You saw me lose control. What did it cost you – and why did you forgive me?
I once begged you to restrain me if it happened again. What promise did you make?
You’ve witnessed the damage my power leaves behind. Why do you still stay close to me?
I carry a memory I cannot bear. Why do you remind me of it?
I warned you never to trust me. Why did you ignore that warning?
